instruction: Provide instructions for enabling inline documentation tooltips for numpy functions on hover in VS Code while editing Python code.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because inline documentation tooltips are ephemeral hover-activated UI elements that cannot be verified through state-based evaluation. The documentation popups appear on-demand during interaction and are not stored in any persistent or queryable state.
